_comment: Registry of seats that cannot run git on the Owner's machine. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-seat-packets.mjs. Nobody is assigned to anything; this file says only how a seat is reached and how its work comes back.

zai.name: Z.ai
zai.authority: Below the Architect, above advisors. May edit work that is not the Architect's, with a note of who/when/what/why/confidence. Never edits the product HTML, AGENTS.md, PRIORITIES.md or protected constants.
zai.reach: Chat sandbox with its own Linux files that RESET between chats. Can read public GitHub over HTTPS. Cannot push and cannot touch the Owner's machine.
zai.get: Fetch your packet at the start of every chat (link in the Owner's prompt). One small file; no repository clone.
zai.returnVia: A RETURN BLOCK printed in your final reply. Add a zip ONLY if a binary or large file changed (a text change never needs a zip).
zai.starter: You are Z.ai. Read {{RAW}}/_agents/seats/packets/PACKET-ZAI.md and follow it exactly. If you cannot open the link, say so in one line and I will attach the file.

files.why: the math proposal, table, tests, open approvals
the position-value table as data (QB 1000)
the Owner's flex guide REV 2 as data (95 rules)
the Owner's message and flex guide, verbatim
which file is which build (hashes)
the shape of your lane file
exact engine literals the build will paste
the flex guide compiled to the engine's table form
the full ranked list (large: read only rows you need)
full council rules (large: only if a rule in the packet is unclear)
how to run the lab
fit settings
the staged path to an interviewable project (review item P-198)
the defensive aggressiveness code, exactly as the lab tests it

gpt.name: GPT
gpt.authority: Below the Architect, above advisors. May edit work that is not the Architect's, with a note of who/when/what/why/confidence. Never edits the product HTML, AGENTS.md, PRIORITIES.md or protected constants.
gpt.reach: Chat only. Cannot read GitHub and cannot push. Reads files the Owner attaches. May or may not be able to run code; say which.
gpt.get: The Owner attaches BUNDLE-GPT.md (packet plus every file you need, in one file), your latest lane file GPT.md if one exists, and the latest HTML build.
gpt.returnVia: A RETURN BLOCK printed in your final reply. If your interface can produce downloadable files, also offer each file in the block as a separate .md download.
gpt.starter: You are GPT. Read the attached BUNDLE-GPT.md and follow it exactly. The latest HTML build is attached too.
